notes.title: v0.3.0 – The Path Unfolds
notes.content:
What’s New


Progression with Purpose – Explore 9 new maps designed to introduce core mechanics through light storytelling. Game progression now unfolds with purpose.

Mouse Support is Here – Full mouse LMB/RMB functionality is now live across menus and gameplay.

Navigation Rework – Enemies now follow clear, rule-based paths. That means behavior is more predictable.

Optimized Assets & Models – We've gone under the hood to tighten up performance. It runs smoother, looks better, and loads faster.

Steam Stats & Rich Presence – Show off your progress and see what your friends are up to with integrated Steam features.


Known Issues

If you're using Steam Remote Play, make sure to disable Steam Input in the controller settings. Steam Input can cause crashes with controller use and Remote Play at the moment—we're on it, but this should help for now.

notes.title: v0.2.2 – Toolkit Expanded
notes.content:
What’s New


 Prepare the Defense – Turrets no longer auto-reload between waves! Keep your storage stocked and ready, defense now takes real preparation
 Single-use Items in Data Core Shops – No need to learn and craft every tool. Dynamite and other items are now available as single-use purchases directly from the Data Core!
 Turret Evolution – Basic ballistic and energy turrets can now evolve into specialized versions! Just make sure to provide them with an Expansion Kit
 More Energy Turrets – We've expanded your arsenal with more energy turret options. They're now a truly viable part of your defense strategy!
 Automation Begins – Introducing machines that handle auto-crafting and drones that automatically reload your turrets
 Achievements Added – A new set of achievements has arrived. Can you collect them all?


Known Issues

If you're using Steam Remote Play, make sure to disable Steam Input in the controller settings. Steam Input can cause crashes with controller use and Remote Play at the moment—we're on it, but this should help for now.

notes.title: v0.1.0 – Foundations Refined
notes.content:
What’s New


 UI Overhaul – The whole interface got a smoother, cleaner redesign. Easier to use, easier on the eyes
 Gameplay Improvements – Core gameplay has been streamlined. Includes 16 craftable recipes to experiment with!
 New Perks – We added 17 new perks to shake things up and give you more flexibility in your playstyle
 Visual Improvement – Improved lighting, visuals, and better camera behavior to make everything feel more polished


Known Issues

If you're using Steam Remote Play, make sure to disable Steam Input in the controller settings. Steam Input can cause crashes with controller use and Remote Play at the moment—we're on it, but this should help for now.
